summary.zh-CN: 大型工具会话重载最快约 6 倍，Panel App 可加入主侧栏，QQ 投递更可靠，运行故障也能沿日志证据排查。
summary.en-US: Tool-heavy sessions reopen up to about 6× faster, Panel Apps can live in the main sidebar, QQ delivery is more resilient, and runtime failures are traceable.

title.zh-CN: 大型工具会话最快约 6 倍
title.en-US: Large tool-heavy sessions reopen up to about 6× faster

body.zh-CN: 首屏先返回工具摘要，完整参数与结果在展开处理过程时按消息加载；44.5MB 压力会话的首屏响应从 12.96MB 降到 261.85KB。
body.en-US: The first view returns tool summaries, while full arguments and results load per message on expansion; the initial response for a 44.5MB stress session fell from 12.96MB to 261.85KB.

title.zh-CN: Panel App 可以加入主侧栏
title.en-US: Panel Apps can live in the main sidebar

body.zh-CN: 从 Apps 列表或运行中 App 添加常用入口；禁用时隐藏、重新启用后恢复，卸载或删除时自动清理。
body.en-US: Add frequently used entries from the Apps list or a running App; entries hide while disabled, return when re-enabled, and are removed on uninstall or deletion.

title.zh-CN: 运行故障可以沿日志证据排查
title.en-US: Runtime failures are traceable through log evidence

body.zh-CN: 结构化诊断覆盖服务、扩展、配置、渠道、Agent、定时任务、工具和网络请求，内置 AI 可按时间、结果、原因码与关联 ID 查询。
body.en-US: Structured diagnostics cover services, extensions, configuration, channels, Agents, scheduled work, tools, and network requests, with AI-assisted queries by time, outcome, reason code, and correlation ID.

title.zh-CN: QQ 断线恢复和消息重试更可靠
title.en-US: More reliable QQ reconnects and message retries

body.zh-CN: 短暂网关断线后主动恢复连接；入站提交失败不会被误记为已处理，同一消息可以安全重试。
body.en-US: QQ reconnects after short gateway interruptions, and failed inbound submissions are not marked as processed, allowing safe retries.

title.en-US: Cancellation has a distinct terminal state

body.zh-CN: 工具和 Agent 取消会记录为 cancelled，不再与成功或普通失败混淆。
body.en-US: Cancelled tools and Agent runs are recorded as cancelled instead of being confused with success or a generic failure.

title.zh-CN: 小会话保持原有加载方式
title.en-US: Small sessions keep their existing loading behavior

body.zh-CN: 普通小会话仍一次加载完整内容；分级加载只用于大型工具历史。
body.en-US: Small sessions still load complete content in one pass; tiered loading applies only to large tool histories.

title.zh-CN: 诊断默认保护私密内容
title.en-US: Diagnostics protect private content by default

body.zh-CN: 诊断日志不记录消息正文、工具参数与结果、完整 URL、用户身份或凭据。
body.en-US: Diagnostics omit message bodies, tool arguments and results, full URLs, user identities, and credentials.
